title: Beef & Black Bean Chilli with Sweet Potato
description: Lean ground beef simmered with beans, peppers and warm spices, topped with baked sweet potato wedges.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into wedges
steps: Bake the sweet potato wedges until tender.
Brown the beef, then sauté the vegetables and spices, and return the beef.
Add the beans, tomatoes and broth, simmer 20 minutes, and serve topped with the sweet potato wedges.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food beef recipe collection

notes: Sweet potato's resistant starch feeds gut bacteria — pair it with the lean beef here for bioavailable iron too.
